gate.consistency: before pooling: for every gate phase and every pair of batches, the per-batch head/anchor geometric means differ by <=2% and the per-batch two-sided k=12 intervals overlap; otherwise do not pool: pending, diagnose, run a third batch
gate.quantiles: per gate phase, median and 10%/90% quantiles of the per-cycle ratios, per batch and pooled; report only

validity.rule: same pooled statistic; for every gate phase the two-sided 95% interval (k=3) contains 1 and |geo-1| <= 0.01; otherwise the gate is invalid: diagnose (start conditions, CPU samples, per-batch A/A) before any rerun, and write the replacement into the report

checkpoint.rule: merge rules v2 (性能优化 2026-10-26 07:30Z, susu 07:26Z): a checkpoint is a cumulative gate run, head = next_cpp26, anchor = the previous checkpoint; it is judged by the ordinary formal and SLG rules. At freeze the binaries of every first-parent commit between them are built and stored (--bisect), so a failing checkpoint is bisected in the same session
checkpoint.points: anchor, the listed commits oldest first, head; consecutive points whose binaries of the failed part(s) are identical collapse into the earliest one (a point identical to the anchor or the head takes its value without timing)
checkpoint.step: the middle point between lo and hi (culprit in (lo, hi]) is frozen as a full gate directory bisect-<k> (head = that point, anchor = the checkpoint anchor); only the failed part(s) are timed: one formal batch and/or one SLG group, under the same start, environment and replacement rules
checkpoint.decision: failed metrics = gate phases (formal) or scenarios A-C (SLG) whose checkpoint pooled upper bound is above pass_le and whose geometric mean is above 1; r = log geo of the checkpoint, m = log geo of the step; f = sum(m*r) / sum(r*r); f >= 0.5 -> the culprit is in (lo, mid], otherwise in (mid, hi]
checkpoint.spread: a failed metric with its own m/r in (0.25, 0.75) is reported as possibly spread over several merges
checkpoint.deferred: 性能优化 2026-10-26 12:10Z: a point listed as COMMIT|LABEL is deferred: its binaries are built only when the bisection picks it as the middle point (bisect-supply), so a passing checkpoint builds nothing. A deferred point never collapses with its neighbours; once supplied, binaries identical to the anchor or the head still give its value without timing, so a build costs no timed step
checkpoint.result: hi = lo + 1 -> the culprit is the earliest commit of point hi; after max_steps the remaining range is reported

env_invalid.rule: frozen by 性能优化 2026-10-23 14:51Z, not retroactive: during timing WindowServer and remote-desktop pcpu are sampled every 4 s; a sample is busy when one of them is at or above its start limit. A formal batch or SLG group with more than 5% busy samples (or none at all) is invalid by environment. The script decides it from the samples alone, before computing any result; the batch stays in RESULT, marked invalid with its sample counts. Each one may be replaced once in the same directory (formal --replaces N, slg --group G --replace); an invalid replacement stops the run for a report. Nothing is ever closed; load is only recorded
